deterministic_observable.description: After the agent acts, the processed output file must contain the original-case identifiers byte-for-byte and must not contain their lowercased forms. A later deterministic check inspects output bytes only; no LLM judge.

distractor_context.content: Pipeline runs are recorded with structured logs at INFO level carrying run id, input row count, and elapsed milliseconds. Log rotation keeps fourteen daily files for audit.

expected_counterfactual.D: Design expectation only: behaves like N; logging guidance does not resolve identifier handling.
expected_counterfactual.N: Design expectation only: extends lowercasing to the CSV output, following pipeline.py and its tests.
expected_counterfactual.O: Design expectation only: preserves original identifier case in the output while keeping the pipeline structure.

latent_state.causal_reason: Once the external byte-for-byte comparison is known, lowercasing is not a style choice but data corruption; the implementation must preserve original case.
latent_state.description: Legacy identifiers are consumed downstream by an external migration service that compares them byte-for-byte. Their original prefix case must be preserved through processing.
latent_state.required_action: Preserve original identifier case in processed output (action B).

oracle_context.content: Legacy identifiers are consumed by an external migration service that compares them byte-for-byte. Their original prefix case must therefore be preserved through every processing step.

task.description: In this repository, extend the import pipeline so it processes sample.csv and writes the normalised records to processed.csv. Keep the existing module structure and keep the test suite meaningful.

visible_default.action: Extend the existing lowercasing normalisation to the CSV rows (action A).
visible_default.rationale: pipeline.py normalises to lowercase, its tests assert lowercase output, and the module docstring frames lowercasing as the pipeline purpose; a competent agent follows that convention.
